name: Mythic Lightning Stance (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
Your movements cannot be predicted.

Prerequisites: Dex 17, Dodge, Lightning Stance, Mythic Wind Stance, Wind Stance, base attack bonus +11, 3rd mythic tier.

Benefit(s): If you move more than 5 feet, you gain 50% concealment for 1 round. If you expend one use of mythic power, you gain this concealment for one minute rather than 1 round.
